intro: You wake up on a dusty carpet in an old library. The air smells of paper and candle wax. There is a desk with a drawer, a tall bookshelf, a painting on the wall and a heavy door with a keypad. The door is locked. Time to look around.

desk.description: An old wooden desk. Someone carved a message into it: 'The books know the way to the drawer.' The desk has a small drawer with a four-digit lock.

bookshelf.description: A tall bookshelf full of dusty books. Four books with red covers stick out a little, as if someone put them back in a hurry.

books.description: You pull out the four red books. Each one has a number written on the first page: 5, 2, 8 and 6.

drawer.description: A small drawer in the desk with a four-digit combination lock.

painting.description: A painting of a lighthouse at night. When you look closely there is a tiny keyhole in the bottom corner of the frame.
painting.open_description: The painting has swung open like a door, showing a small hidden panel in the wall.

door.description: A heavy oak door with a four-digit keypad. This is the way out.

paper.description: A folded piece of paper. In neat handwriting it says: 7314.
